items.source: Supported classes for the type <T> are Integer, Long, Float, Double, Date and classes that implement the TemporalAccessor interface.
items.translation: 支持类型 `<T>` 的类包括 `Integer`、`Long`、`Float`、`Double`、`Date` 以及实现 `TemporalAccessor` 接口的类。

items.source: It is also possible to define a FieldNamingStrategy in the configuration of the client (Elasticsearch Clients). If for example a SnakeCaseFieldNamingStrategy is configured, the property sampleProperty of the object would be mapped to sample_property in Elasticsearch. A FieldNamingStrategy applies to all entities; it can be overwritten by setting a specific name with @Field on a property.
items.translation: 也可以在客户端配置中定义一个FieldNamingStrategy(Elasticsearch 客户端)。例如，如果配置了SnakeCaseFieldNamingStrategy，则对象的属性sampleProperty将被映射到 Elasticsearch 中的sample_property。FieldNamingStrategy适用于所有实体；可以通过在属性上使用@Field设置特定名称来覆盖它。

items.source: Properties that derive from TemporalAccessor or are of type java.util.Date must either have a @Field annotation of type FieldType.Date or a custom converter must be registered for this type. This paragraph describes the use of FieldType.Date.
items.translation: 源自 TemporalAccessor 的属性或类型为 java.util.Date 的属性，必须带有类型为 FieldType.Date 的 @Field 注解，或者为此类型注册自定义转换器。 本段描述了 FieldType.Date 的用法。

items.source: @Transient, @ReadOnlyProperty, @WriteOnlyProperty: see the following section Controlling which properties are written to and read from Elasticsearch for detailed information.
items.translation: @Transient、@ReadOnlyProperty 和 @WriteOnlyProperty：有关详细信息，请参阅以下章节控制写入和读取 Elasticsearch 的属性。

items.source: type: The field type, can be one of Text, Keyword, Long, Integer, Short, Byte, Double, Float, Half_Float, Scaled_Float, Date, Date_Nanos, Boolean, Binary, Integer_Range, Float_Range, Long_Range, Double_Range, Date_Range, Ip_Range, Object, Nested, Ip, TokenCount, Percolator, Flattened, Search_As_You_Type. See Elasticsearch Mapping Types. If the field type is not specified, it defaults to FieldType.Auto. This means, that no mapping entry is written for the property and that Elasticsearch will add a mapping entry dynamically when the first data for this property is stored (check the Elasticsearch documentation for dynamic mapping rules).
items.translation: type：字段类型，可以是 Text、Keyword、Long、Integer、Short、Byte、Double、Float、Half_Float、Scaled_Float、Date、Date_Nanos、Boolean、Binary、Integer_Range、Float_Range、Long_Range、Double_Range、Date_Range、Ip_Range、Object、Nested、Ip、TokenCount、Percolator、Flattened、Search_As_You_Type 之一。 请参阅 Elasticsearch 映射类型。 如果未指定字段类型，则默认为 FieldType.Auto。 这意味着不会为该属性写入任何映射条目，并且当首次存储该属性的数据时，Elasticsearch 会动态添加一个映射条目（请查阅 Elasticsearch 文档以了解动态映射规则）。

items.source: Normally the properties used in an entity are fields of the entity class. There might be cases, when a property value is calculated in the entity and should be stored in Elasticsearch. In this case, the getter method (getProperty()) can be annotated with the @Field annotation, in addition to that the method must be annotated with @AccessType(AccessType.Type .PROPERTY). The third annotation that is needed in such a case is @WriteOnlyProperty, as such a value is only written to Elasticsearch. A full example:
items.translation: 通常情况下，实体中使用的属性是实体类的字段。 在某些情况下，实体的属性值是在实体中计算得出的，并且需要存储到 Elasticsearch 中。在这种情况下，除了使用 @Field 注解标注 getter 方法（getProperty()）之外，还必须将该方法用 @AccessType(AccessType.Type.PROPERTY) 进行标注。在此类情况下，还需要添加第三个注解 @WriteOnlyProperty，因为该值仅被写入 Elasticsearch。 完整示例如下：

items.source: createIndex: flag whether to create an index on repository bootstrapping. Default value is true. See Automatic creation of indices with the corresponding mapping
items.translation: createIndex：标志是否在存储库引导时创建索引。默认值为 true。 参见使用相应映射自动创建索引

items.source: analyzer, searchAnalyzer, normalizer for specifying custom analyzers and normalizer.
items.translation: 指定自定义分析器和标准化器的 `analyzer`、`searchAnalyzer` 和 `normalizer`。

items.source: @GeoPoint: Marks a field as geo_point datatype. Can be omitted if the field is an instance of the GeoPoint class.
items.translation: @GeoPoint：将字段标记为 geo_point 数据类型。如果该字段是 GeoPoint 类的实例，则可以省略此注解。

items.source: There are two attributes of the @Field annotation that define which date format information is written to the mapping (also see Elasticsearch Built In Formats and Elasticsearch Custom Date Formats)
items.translation: `@Field` 注解有两个属性用于定义写入映射的日期格式信息（另请参阅Elasticsearch 内置格式和Elasticsearch 自定义日期格式）。

items.source: The format attribute is used to define at least one of the predefined formats. If it is not defined, then a default value of _date_optional_time and epoch_millis is used.
items.translation: `format` 属性用于定义至少一个预定义格式。如果未定义该属性，则默认使用 `_date_optional_time` 和 `epoch_millis`。

items.source: The pattern attribute can be used to add additional custom format strings. If you want to use only custom date formats, you must set the format property to empty {}.
items.translation:
`pattern` 属性可用于添加额外的自定义格式字符串。  
如果您只想使用自定义日期格式，必须将 `format` 属性设置为空 `{}`。

items.source: Type hints can be disabled for the whole application by overriding the method writeTypeHints() in a configuration class derived from AbstractElasticsearchConfiguration (see Elasticsearch Clients).
items.translation: 可以通过在继承自AbstractElasticsearchConfiguration的配置类中重写writeTypeHints()方法来禁用整个应用程序的类型提示（参见Elasticsearch 客户端）。

items.source: Geospatial types like Point & GeoPoint are converted into lat/lon pairs.
items.translation: 地理空间类型（如Point和GeoPoint）会被转换为纬度/经度对。

items.source: Spring Data Elasticsearch supports the GeoJson types by providing an interface GeoJson and implementations for the different geometries. They are mapped to Elasticsearch documents according to the GeoJson specification. The corresponding properties of the entity are specified in the index mappings as geo_shape when the index mappings is written. (check the Elasticsearch documentation as well)
items.translation: Spring Data Elasticsearch 通过提供 GeoJson 接口以及针对不同几何类型的实现来支持 GeoJson 类型。 它们根据 GeoJson 规范映射到 Elasticsearch 文档中。 当写入索引映射时，实体对应的属性在索引映射中被指定为 geo_shape。（请同时参考Elasticsearch 文档）

items.source: Looking at the Configuration from the previous section ElasticsearchCustomConversions allows registering specific rules for mapping domain and simple types.
items.translation: 查看上一节中的Configuration，ElasticsearchCustomConversions允许为映射域和简单类型注册特定规则。

items.source: indexName: the name of the index to store this entity in. This can contain a SpEL template expression like "log-#{T(java.time.LocalDate).now().toString()}"
items.translation: indexName：用于存储此实体的索引名称。 它可以包含一个 SpEL 模板表达式，例如 "log-#{T(java.time.LocalDate).now().toString()}"。

items.source: @Field: Applied at the field level and defines properties of the field, most of the attributes map to the respective Elasticsearch Mapping definitions (the following list is not complete, check the annotation Javadoc for a complete reference):
items.translation: @Field：应用于字段级别，用于定义字段的属性。大多数属性对应于相应的 Elasticsearch 映射 定义（以下列表不完整，请查看注解的 Javadoc 以获取完整参考）：

items.source: format: One or more built-in date formats, see the next section Date format mapping.
items.translation: format：一个或多个内置日期格式，详见下一节日期格式映射。

items.source: pattern: One or more custom date formats, see the next section Date format mapping.
items.translation: pattern：一个或多个自定义日期格式，请参见下一节日期格式映射。

items.source: store: Flag whether the original field value should be store in Elasticsearch, default value is false.
items.translation: store：标志是否应将原始字段值存储到 Elasticsearch 中，默认值为 false。

items.source: @ValueConverter defines a class to be used to convert the given property. In difference to a registered Spring Converter this only converts the annotated property and not every property of the given type.
items.translation: @ValueConverter 定义了一个类，用于转换给定的属性。与注册的 Spring Converter 不同，它仅转换带有注解的属性，而不是给定类型的每个属性。

items.source: When a field is annotated with a type of one of Integer_Range, Float_Range, Long_Range, Double_Range, Date_Range, or Ip_Range the field must be an instance of a class that will be mapped to an Elasticsearch range, for example:
items.translation: 当字段被标注为 Integer_Range、Float_Range、Long_Range、Double_Range、Date_Range 或 Ip_Range 中的一种类型时，该字段必须是将被映射到 Elasticsearch 范围（range）的类的实例，例如：

items.source: Mapping uses type hints embedded in the document sent to the server to allow generic type mapping. Those type hints are represented as _class attributes within the document and are written for each aggregate root.
items.translation: 映射使用嵌入在发送至服务器的文档中的类型提示来实现泛型类型映射。这些类型提示表示为文档内的_class属性，并为每个聚合根编写。

items.source: For values inside Collections apply the same mapping rules as for aggregate roots when it comes to type hints and Custom Conversions.
items.translation: 对于集合中的值，在应用类型提示和自定义转换时，遵循与聚合根相同的映射规则。

items.source: For values inside Maps apply the same mapping rules as for aggregate roots when it comes to type hints and Custom Conversions. However the Map key needs to a String to be processed by Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 对于 Map 内部的值，其类型提示和自定义转换的映射规则与聚合根相同。然而，Map 的键必须是字符串，才能被 Elasticsearch 处理。

items.source: Spring Data Elasticsearch Object Mapping is the process that maps a Java object - the domain entity - into the JSON representation that is stored in Elasticsearch and back. The class that is internally used for this mapping is the MappingElasticsearchConverter.
items.translation: Spring Data Elasticsearch 对象映射是将 Java 对象（即领域实体）映射为存储在 Elasticsearch 中的 JSON 表示形式，以及从该形式反向映射的过程。内部用于此映射的类是 MappingElasticsearchConverter。

items.source: The Metamodel based approach uses domain type information for reading/writing from/to Elasticsearch. This allows to register Converter instances for specific domain type mapping.
items.translation: 基于元模型的方法利用领域类型信息来从 Elasticsearch 读取和写入数据。这使得可以为特定的领域类型映射注册Converter实例。

items.source: The MappingElasticsearchConverter uses metadata to drive the mapping of objects to documents. The metadata is taken from the entity’s properties which can be annotated.
items.translation: MappingElasticsearchConverter 利用元数据来驱动对象到文档的映射。这些元数据来自实体的属性，这些属性可以添加注解。

items.source: @Document: Applied at the class level to indicate this class is a candidate for mapping to the database. The most important attributes are (check the API documentation for the complete list of attributes):
items.translation: @Document：在类级别应用，用于指示该类是数据库映射的候选者。 最重要的属性如下（完整属性列表请查阅 API 文档）：

items.source: @Id: Applied at the field level to mark the field used for identity purpose.
items.translation: @Id：应用于字段级别，用于标记用于标识目的的字段。

items.source: @PersistenceConstructor: Marks a given constructor - even a package protected one - to use when instantiating the object from the database. Constructor arguments are mapped by name to the key values in the retrieved Document.
items.translation: @PersistenceConstructor：标记一个给定的构造函数（即使是包级私有的），用于从数据库实例化对象。构造函数的参数通过名称映射到检索到的文档中的键值。

items.source: name: The name of the field as it will be represented in the Elasticsearch document, if not set, the Java field name is used.
items.translation: name：该字段在 Elasticsearch 文档中的表示名称；若未设置，则使用 Java 字段名。

items.source: @Transient: A property annotated with this annotation will not be written to the mapping, it’s value will not be sent to Elasticsearch and when documents are returned from Elasticsearch, this property will not be set in the resulting entity.
items.translation: @Transient：带有此注解的属性不会被写入映射，其值不会发送到 Elasticsearch，并且当从 Elasticsearch 返回文档时，该属性不会在生成的实体中设置。

items.source: @ReadOnlyProperty: A property with this annotation will not have its value written to Elasticsearch, but when returning data, the property will be filled with the value returned in the document from Elasticsearch. One use case for this are runtime fields defined in the index mapping.
items.translation: @ReadOnlyProperty：带有此注解的属性不会将其值写入 Elasticsearch，但在返回数据时，该属性将从 Elasticsearch 文档中返回的值进行填充。 一个使用场景是索引映射中定义的运行时字段。

items.source: @WriteOnlyProperty: A property with this annotation will have its value stored in Elasticsearch but will not be set with any value when reading document. This can be used for example for synthesized fields which should go into the Elasticsearch index but are not used elsewhere.
items.translation: @WriteOnlyProperty：带有此注解的属性，其值将被存储到 Elasticsearch 中，但在读取文档时不会被设置任何值。例如，这可用于那些需要进入 Elasticsearch 索引但不在其他地方使用的合成字段。

items.source: Check the code of the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.DateFormat enum for a complete list of predefined values and their patterns.
items.translation: 检查org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.DateFormat枚举的代码，以获取预定义值及其模式的完整列表。

items.source: As an alternative Spring Data Elasticsearch provides a Range<T> class so that the previous example can be written as:
items.translation: 作为替代方案，Spring Data Elasticsearch 提供了一个 `Range<T>` 类，使得上述示例可以改写为：

items.source: Without further configuration, Spring Data Elasticsearch will use the property name of an object as field name in Elasticsearch. This can be changed for individual field by using the @Field annotation on that property.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring Data Elasticsearch 会将对象的属性名用作 Elasticsearch 中的字段名。可以通过在该属性上使用 `@Field` 注解来为单个字段更改此行为。

items.source: This annotation can be set on a String property of an entity. This property will not be written to the mapping, it will not be stored in Elasticsearch and its value will not be read from an Elasticsearch document. After an entity is persisted, for example with a call to ElasticsearchOperations.save(T entity), the entity returned from that call will contain the name of the index that an entity was saved to in that property. This is useful when the index name is dynamically set by a bean, or when writing to a write alias.
items.translation: 此注解可设置于实体的 String 属性上。 该属性不会写入映射，也不会存储在 Elasticsearch 中，其值也不会从 Elasticsearch 文档中读取。 在实体被持久化之后（例如通过调用 `ElasticsearchOperations.save(T entity)`），从此调用返回的实体将在该属性中包含实体被保存到的索引名称。 这在索引名称由 Bean 动态设置或写入写别名时非常有用。

items.source: Type hints can be configured to hold custom information. Use the @TypeAlias annotation to do so.
items.translation: 类型提示可以配置为包含自定义信息。请使用 @TypeAlias 注解来实现此功能。

items.source: As an alternative they can be disabled for a single index with the @Document annotation:
items.translation: 作为替代方案，它们可以通过在单个索引上使用 `@Document` 注解来禁用：

items.translation: 以下是可用的注释：

items.source: The mapping metadata infrastructure is defined in a separate spring-data-commons project that is technology agnostic.
items.translation: 映射元数据基础设施定义在一个独立的、与具体技术无关的 spring-data-commons 项目中。

items.source: This section details the annotations that define if the value of a property is written to or read from Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 本节详细说明用于定义属性值是写入还是从 Elasticsearch 读取的注解。

items.source: Putting some value into such a property does not set the index into which an entity is stored!
items.translation: 为属性设置值并不会指定存储该实体的索引！

items.source:
It may be necessary to disable writing of type hints when the index that should be used already exists without having the type hints defined in its mapping and with the mapping mode set to strict.
In this case, writing the type hint will produce an error, as the field cannot be added automatically.
items.translation: 当应使用的索引已存在，但其映射中未定义类型提示且映射模式设置为严格时，可能需要禁用类型提示的写入。在这种情况下，尝试写入类型提示将导致错误，因为该字段无法自动添加。

items.source: If you are using a custom date format, you need to use uuuu for the year instead of yyyy. This is due to a change in Elasticsearch 7.
items.translation: 如果您使用自定义日期格式，需要将年份的格式从 yyyy 改为 uuuu。 这是由于 Elasticsearch 7 中的日期格式变更所致。

items.source: Make sure to add types with @TypeAlias to the initial entity set (AbstractElasticsearchConfiguration#getInitialEntitySet) to already have entity information available when first reading data from the store.
items.translation: 确保在初始实体集（AbstractElasticsearchConfiguration#getInitialEntitySet）中添加带有 @TypeAlias 的类型，以便在首次从存储读取数据时即可拥有实体信息。

items.source: 1 By default the domain types class name is used for the type hint.
items.translation: 1 默认情况下，使用域类型的类名作为类型提示。

items.source: 1 The configured alias is used when writing the entity.
items.translation: 1 写入实体时将使用配置的别名。

items.source: Type hints will not be written for nested Objects unless the properties type is Object, an interface or the actual value type does not match the properties declaration.
items.translation: 除非属性类型为 Object、接口，或实际值类型与属性声明不匹配，否则不会为嵌套对象编写类型提示。

items.source: We strongly advise against disabling Type Hints. Only do this if you are forced to. Disabling type hints can lead to documents not being retrieved correctly from Elasticsearch in case of polymorphic data or document retrieval may fail completely.
items.translation: 我们强烈建议不要禁用类型提示。 除非迫不得已，否则请勿执行此操作。 禁用类型提示可能导致在存在多态数据的情况下无法从 Elasticsearch 正确检索文档，或者文档检索完全失败。
